slices.reason: Legacy ingress allows 5 MiB images, while the controlled operation JSON and canonical dispatch envelope are 64 KiB scalar boundaries. P7.3 must own bounded streaming, opaque handle lifetime, one-time consumption, read-back, cleanup and live evidence without widening the operation body limit.
Membership association, owner assignment and list transfer need a dedicated contact-list-owner fixture graph.
Payment and dedication records require an isolated financial fixture graph and ledger reconciliation.
Appointment create/update and ownership assignment require an isolated appointment fixture.
Onboarding creates a multi-record contact graph and needs an explicit known-ID cleanup contract.
Fee and stor-lesson updates require monetary and status reconciliation.
Attendance create/upsert requires a dedicated attendance key and cleanup graph.
